name: Badlands
summary: Dust storms sweep across the Badlands, where rival forces hold ground in dwarven Khaz Modan. Dark Iron dwarves, troggs, Dustbelcher ogres, and black dragonkin crowd this frontier between Loch Modan and Searing Gorge. Uldaman's titan ruins and the Horde stronghold of Kargath make it a crossroads.

sections.title: A Bleak Frontier
sections.body: South of Loch Modan's green hills, you enter a hot basin of barren flats and rugged ravines. Coyotes, cougars, and vultures roam the land, and fierce sandstorms can hide the horizon. Dustbelcher ogres keep crude camps across the plateaus. At Angor Fortress, the Dark Iron clan fortifies its hold and clashes with anyone who trespasses.

sections.title: The Secrets of Uldaman
sections.body: Among the northern bluffs lies Uldaman, an underground complex carved by the titan-forged earthen. Ironforge prospectors recently uncovered it, revealing monumental secrets about the ancient ancestry of the dwarven race. Their digging awoke hordes of vicious Stonevault troggs and animated earthen guardians. The creatures slaughtered the archaeological teams and turned the digsites outside into bloody skirmish grounds.

sections.title: The Shadows of Kargath and Lethlor
sections.body: The Horde holds one of its most precarious footholds in the southern Eastern Kingdoms here. Kargath, in the northwest, gives Warchief Thrall's forces a base to watch the rogue Dark Horde in nearby Blackrock Mountain. Far to the east, Lethlor Ravine cuts a treacherous chasm through the land. Beneath the mountains' shadow, black whelps and dangerous black dragonkin guard their brooding grounds.

faq.q: Why is the Horde stationed in the Badlands?
faq.answer: Warchief Thrall ordered the Kargath Expeditionary Force to establish Kargath. Under Warlord Goretooth, the outpost gives the Horde a staging ground to strike Rend Blackhand and his renegade Blackrock clan inside Blackrock Mountain.

faq.q: How do you get to the Badlands?
faq.answer: Alliance travelers can walk south from Loch Modan through the Maker's Terrace pass. Horde travelers must trek farther through Loch Modan's southern hills or cross Searing Gorge by its western mountain pass. Then they can use Kargath's flight master.

Uldaman is a vast underground vault built by the ancient titans and their earthen servants. Dwarven prospectors recently excavated it in search of the secrets of dwarven origins, awakening buried earthen constructs and primitive Stonevault troggs. The ruin is now a deadly battleground.

faq.q: What are the black dragons doing in Lethlor Ravine?
faq.answer: Black dragons use Lethlor Ravine in the east as a breeding and nesting canyon. Drakes and whelps guard the clutch, which preys on wanderers and guards the eastern reaches against trespassers.
The hostile Dark Iron clan holds Angor Fortress south of Uldaman. From there, the clan conducts reconnaissance, contests the titan digsites, and battles neighboring ogres and surface explorers.

faq.q: Are there any friendly settlements for Alliance players here?
faq.answer: No fortified Alliance settlements or flight masters stand in the Badlands. Ironforge prospectors and solitary hermits keep scattered, fragile camps near the digsites. Alliance travelers must rely on Loch Modan or Searing Gorge for extensive supplies.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can seek answers about your ancestry in Uldaman. Discoveries about the titan-forged earthen reshaped dwarven understanding of history.
As a member of the Horde, you find your military sanctuary at Kargath, deep in Khaz Modan. The stronghold stands on the front line against the Dark Horde in Blackrock Mountain.
As a miner, you can find iron, gold, truesilver, and mithril in this arid land. Rare Indurium deposits lie in Uldaman and the surrounding terrain.
